visualReview.notes: Personally inspected all 7 current portable frames. Three complete separate structures are visible: stepped remaining reactor concrete body and low retained deck, whole long turbine hall with both low attachments/four roof vents, and open tapered lattice stack with central flue capped at 59 m. Whole east/west views show all three. There is no restored tall 1971 reactor upper hall, 120 m stack or solid compound extrusion. Reactor retained deck/cleaned damage envelope is a coarse estimate, not a measured scar or debris reconstruction.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Personally inspected all 7 current shared frames, including the north-up geographic placement. Distinct concrete reactor/deck/foundations, light corrugated turbine walls/painted roof and red-white painted lattice/flue bindings are coherent, with readable open bracing. Whole views show all components at their original relative locations; close angles occlude parts of the reactor behind the turbine or stack. Six material groups stay within budget. No photographic texture is embedded.
